Set SpawnBot's z_index to 1.

+++ /workspace/.godot/verify_spawn_points.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+extends SceneTree
+
+class MarkerOverlay:
+	extends Node2D
+	var markers: Array[Marker2D] = []
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		for marker in markers:
+			var p := marker.global_position
+			var color := Color.CYAN if marker.name == &"SpawnTop" else Color.MAGENTA
+			draw_circle(p, 1.0, color, false, 0.2, true)
+			draw_line(p - Vector2(1.7, 0), p + Vector2(1.7, 0), color, 0.2, true)
+			draw_line(p - Vector2(0, 1.7), p + Vector2(0, 1.7), color, 0.2, true)
+
+func _initialize() -> void:
+	call_deferred("verify")
+
+func verify() -> void:
+	var scene := load("res://scenes/main.tscn").instantiate()
+	root.add_child(scene)
+	var trap: Node2D = scene.get_node("Trap")
+	var points: Node2D = trap.get_node("SpawningPoints")
+	assert(points.get_child_count() == 2)
+	var top: Marker2D = points.get_node("SpawnTop")
+	var bot: Marker2D = points.get_node("SpawnBot")
+	assert(bot.z_index == 1)
+	var sprite: Sprite2D = trap.get_node("Sprite2D")
+	var top_pixel := sprite.to_local(top.global_position) + sprite.texture.get_size() / 2
+	var bot_pixel := sprite.to_local(bot.global_position) + sprite.texture.get_size() / 2
+	assert(top_pixel.distance_to(Vector2(1188, 722)) < 0.01)
+	assert(bot_pixel.distance_to(Vector2(802, 749)) < 0.01)
+	print("Verified scene hierarchy, marker types, and SpawnBot z_index = 1.")
+	print("Texture alignment: SpawnTop=", top_pixel, "; SpawnBot=", bot_pixel)
+	var camera := Camera2D.new()
+	camera.position = sprite.to_global(Vector2(1000, 640) - sprite.texture.get_size() / 2)
+	camera.zoom = Vector2(7, 7)
+	scene.add_child(camera)
+	var overlay := MarkerOverlay.new()
+	overlay.z_index = 100
+	overlay.markers = [top, bot]
+	scene.add_child(overlay)
+	for marker in [top, bot]:
+		var label := Label.new()
+		label.text = marker.name
+		label.position = marker.global_position + Vector2(2, 2)
+		label.scale = Vector2.ONE / 7
+		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.CYAN if marker == top else Color.MAGENTA)
+		label.add_theme_color_override("font_shadow_color", Color.BLACK)
+		label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_x", 1)
+		label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_y", 1)
+		overlay.add_child(label)
